# accepts payment method

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:acceptsPaymentMethod`](gmeow-acceptsPaymentMethod.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/acceptsPaymentMethod>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

Relates an organization to a payment method it accepts — reusing the finance-slice [`gmeow:PaymentMethod`](../classes/gmeow-PaymentMethod.md) individuals (cash, credit card, bank transfer, cryptocurrency, …). Non-functional: a business may accept several. Projects to [schema:paymentAccepted](https://schema.org/paymentAccepted) (the method's label).
